Identifies melanoma metaprogrammes, scores individual cells and infers the two melanoma trajectories.

**Inputs:** Annotated cells from Xenium notebook 01 and the trajectory-outlier coordinates in `paper_data/Xenium/inputs`.

**Outputs:** Metaprogramme gene sets, scored melanoma cells, diffusion-map and Slingshot models, and corrected trajectories in `data/`; gene lists, summary tables and discovery/trajectory figures in `results/`.

## Melanoma metaprogrammes

```{r gene_network_helpers}

library(igraph)
library(tidygraph)

## We check the strength of association of two genes by checking the number of cells where both genes are coexpressed relative to the individual expression of each gene (kappa stat)
co_detection_kappa <- function(counts) {
  detected <- counts > 0
  n <- ncol(detected)
  positive <- Matrix::rowSums(detected)
  negative <- n - positive
  both <- as.matrix(detected %*% Matrix::t(detected))
  neither <- n - outer(positive, rep(1, length(positive))) - outer(rep(1, length(positive)), positive) + both
  expected <- (outer(positive, positive) + outer(negative, negative)) / n^2
  observed <- (both + neither) / n
  (observed - expected) / (1 - expected)
}

find_gene_communities <- function(graph, seed) {
  set.seed(seed)
  graph <- tidygraph::as_tbl_graph(graph) %>% mutate(community = as.factor(tidygraph::group_louvain(weights = weight)))
  tibble::as_tibble(graph) %>% transmute(gene = name, community = as.character(community))
}

community_metrics <- function(graph, communities) {
  lookup <- setNames(paste0('comm', communities$community), communities$gene)
  edges <- igraph::as_data_frame(graph, what = 'edges')
  from <- unname(lookup[edges$from])
  to <- unname(lookup[edges$to])
  metrics <- lapply(sort(unique(lookup)), function(community) {
    n <- sum(lookup == community)
    internal <- from == community & to == community
    external <- xor(from == community, to == community)
    iw <- sum(edges$weight[internal])
    ew <- sum(edges$weight[external])
    pi <- n * (n - 1) / 2
    pe <- n * (igraph::vcount(graph) - n)
    data.frame(community = community, n_genes = n, possible_internal_edges = pi, possible_external_edges = pe, internal_edges = sum(internal), external_edges = sum(external), internal_weight = iw, external_weight = ew, internal_edge_density = sum(internal) / pi, external_edge_density = sum(external) / pe, internal_weighted_density = iw / pi, external_weighted_density = ew / pe, intra_external_ratio = (iw / pi) / (ew / pe), conductance = ew / (2 * iw + ew), internal_weight_fraction = iw / (iw + ew)) })
  bind_rows(metrics) %>% arrange(desc(conductance))
}

```

### Melanoma metaprograms

```{r melanoma_metaprograms}

# initial melanoma population
obj <- readRDS(file.path(intermediate_dir, 'annotated.rds'))
mel <- obj[, colnames(obj)[obj$main_lineage == 'Melanoma']]
rm(obj)
gc()

# calculate gene co-detection and its threshold
kappa <- co_detection_kappa(LayerData(mel, assay = 'Xenium', layer = 'counts'))
threshold <- round(mean(kappa[kappa < 1]) + 2.3 * sd(kappa[kappa < 1]), 2)
write.csv(data.frame(cells = ncol(mel), genes = nrow(mel), threshold = threshold), file.path(result_dir, 'melanoma_graph_parameters.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

```

### Co-detection threshold

```{r kappa_threshold_panel}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  # threshold
  values <- kappa[upper.tri(kappa)]
  df <- data.frame(kappa = values[is.finite(values)])
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(kappa)) + geom_histogram(bins = 128, fill = 'grey75', colour = 'grey30', linewidth = 0.15) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0.15, linetype = 'dashed', linewidth = 0.7, colour = 'indianred') +
    annotate('text', x = 0.15, y = Inf, label = 'threshold = 0.15', hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.5, colour = 'indianred', size = 3.5) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 11) + labs(x = "Cohen's kappa", y = 'Gene-pair count')
  save_panel(p, 'S5A_kappa_threshold', 4, 3)
}))

```

### Initial gene communities

```{r initial_gene_communities}

adjacency <- kappa
adjacency[adjacency < threshold] <- 0
graph <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(adjacency, mode = 'undirected', weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
components <- igraph::components(graph)
graph <- igraph::induced_subgraph(graph, igraph::V(graph)[components$membership == which.max(components$csize)])
graph <- igraph::induced_subgraph(graph, igraph::V(graph)[igraph::degree(graph) > 1])

# initial communities
communities <- find_gene_communities(graph, 12345)
write.csv(communities, file.path(result_dir, 'metaprograms_th15.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

# module connectivity
metrics <- community_metrics(graph, communities)
write.csv(metrics, file.path(result_dir, 'melanoma_module_metrics.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

```

### Gene-network plotting

```{r gene_network_plot_helper}

network_panel <- function(graph, membership, name, palette = NULL) {
    V(graph)$comm <- factor(membership$community[match(V(graph)$name, membership$gene)])
    set.seed(1234)
    layout <- create_layout(graph, layout = "fr")
    saveRDS(layout, file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0(name, "_layout.rds")))
    if (name == "S5B_initial_gene_network") 
        return(invisible(layout))
    p <- ggraph(layout) + geom_edge_link(aes(width = weight), alpha = 0.2) +
      geom_node_point(aes(colour = comm), size = 2) + geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE, seed = 1234, 
        size = 3, max.overlaps = Inf) +
      theme_void()
    if (!is.null(palette)) 
        p <- p + scale_colour_manual(values = palette)
    save_panel(p, name, 6, 5)
}

```

### Refine the stress-associated community

```{r refine_stress_community}

# stress communities
stress_community <- sub('comm', '', metrics$community[which.max(metrics$conductance)])
stress_genes <- communities$gene[communities$community == stress_community]
stress_adjacency <- kappa[stress_genes, stress_genes]
stress_adjacency[stress_adjacency < threshold] <- 0
stress_graph <- igraph::graph_from_adjacency_matrix(stress_adjacency, mode = 'undirected', weighted = TRUE, diag = FALSE)
stress <- find_gene_communities(stress_graph, 1)
write.csv(stress, file.path(result_dir, 'metaprograms_stress_th15.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

```

### Stress-associated gene network

```{r stress_community_panel}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  library(ggraph)
  network_panel(stress_graph, stress, 'S5D_stress_gene_network')
}))

```

### Score the seven metaprograms

```{r score_melanoma_metaprograms}

# seven programs
final <- bind_rows(communities[communities$community != stress_community, ], transform(stress, community = as.character(as.integer(community) + 100)))
ids <- sort(unique(as.integer(final$community)))
final$community <- paste0('comm', match(as.integer(final$community), ids))
mp_names <- c(comm1 = 'differentiated_melanocytic', comm2 = 'epithelial_adjacent', comm3 = 'mesenchymal_invasive', comm4 = 'proliferation_cell_cycle', comm5 = 'early_developmental_stress', comm6 = 'nevus_like_senescence', comm7 = 'ifn_associated_stress')
module_sets <- split(final$gene, final$community)[names(mp_names)]
final$metaprogram <- unname(mp_names[final$community])
write.csv(final, file.path(result_dir, 'melanoma_metaprogram_genes.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

# module scores
mel <- AddModuleScore(mel, features = module_sets, name = 'comm', assay = 'Xenium', layer = 'data', ctrl = 5, nbin = 10, seed = 1)
scores <- as.matrix(mel[[]][, names(mp_names)])
call <- apply(scores, 1, function(x) names(mp_names)[which.max(x)])
mel$metaprogram_modulescore_stress_subtype <- call
mel$melanoma_mp <- factor(unname(mp_names[call]), levels = unname(mp_names))
mel@meta.data[unname(mp_names)] <- mel@meta.data[names(mp_names)]

```

### Co-detection across the final metaprograms

```{r metaprogram_codetection_panel}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  library(pheatmap)
  membership <- final

  # matrix order
  comms <- sort(unique(membership$community))
  comm_mat <- outer(comms, comms, Vectorize(function(a, b) mean(kappa[membership$gene[membership$community == a], membership$gene[membership$community == b]])))
  dimnames(comm_mat) <- list(comms, comms)
  diag(comm_mat) <- 1
  comm_order <- comms[hclust(as.dist(1 - comm_mat), method = 'average')$order]
  genes <- unlist(lapply(comm_order, function(comm) {
      selected <- membership$gene[membership$community == comm]
      if (length(selected) > 2) 
          selected <- selected[hclust(as.dist(1 - kappa[selected, selected]), method = "average")$order]
      selected
  }))
  annotation <- data.frame(Community = membership$community[match(genes, membership$gene)], row.names = genes)
  gaps <- head(cumsum(rle(annotation$Community)$lengths), -1)
  palette <- c(comm1 = '#A52A2A', comm2 = '#009E73', comm3 = '#FFC0CB', comm4 = '#CD5C5C', comm5 = '#DAA520', comm6 = '#D55E00', comm7 = '#FF7F50')

  # co-detection matrix
  path <- file.path(result_dir, 'Figure_2A_gene_codetection.pdf')
  pdf(path, width = 15, height = 13, useDingbats = FALSE)
  pheatmap(kappa[genes, genes], display_numbers = ifelse(kappa[genes, genes] > 0.15, '*', ''), cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, annotation_row = annotation, annotation_col = annotation, annotation_colors = list(Community = palette), gaps_row = gaps, gaps_col = gaps, fontsize_row = 6, fontsize_col = 6, border_color = NA)
  dev.off()
  write.csv(data.frame(gene = genes, community = annotation$Community), file.path(result_dir, 'Figure_2A_gene_order.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
}))

```

## Melanoma trajectories

### Trajectory training cells

```{r trajectory_training_cells}

Idents(mel) <- 'melanoma_mp'
features_use <- as.character(unique(mel$melanoma_mp))

# scale scores
training_metadata <- mel[[]]
training_metadata[, features_use] <- scale(training_metadata[, features_use])
training_metadata[, features_use][training_metadata[, features_use] > 3] <- 3
training_metadata[, features_use][training_metadata[, features_use] < -3] <- -3

# sample cells
set.seed(1234)
cells_use <- unlist(lapply(levels(Idents(mel)), function(program) {
    cells <- WhichCells(mel, idents = program)
    sample(cells, size = min(length(cells), 1000))
}))
training <- list(metadata = training_metadata[rownames(training_metadata) %in% cells_use, , drop = FALSE], features = features_use, levels = levels(Idents(mel)))
trajectory_training <- training
trajectory_training$metadata <- trajectory_training$metadata[, c(trajectory_training$features, 'melanoma_mp'), drop = FALSE]
rm(training_metadata)

```

```{r trajectory_plot_helpers}

mp_pal <- c(differentiated_melanocytic = '#A52A2A', epithelial_adjacent = '#009E73', mesenchymal_invasive = '#FFC0CB', proliferation_cell_cycle = '#CD5C5C', early_developmental_stress = '#DAA520', nevus_like_senescence = '#D55E00', ifn_associated_stress = '#FF7F50')
route_cols <- c('Shared Trunk' = '#BDBDBD', 'Lineage 1' = '#E377C2', 'Lineage 2' = '#353C40')
diffusion_labels <- c(differentiated_melanocytic = 'Differentiated', epithelial_adjacent = 'Epithelial-adjacent', mesenchymal_invasive = 'Mesenchymal', proliferation_cell_cycle = 'Proliferation', early_developmental_stress = 'Early developmental', nevus_like_senescence = 'Nevus-like', ifn_associated_stress = 'IFN stress')

open_panel <- function(name) {
    path <- file.path(result_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf"))
    pdf(path, width = 8, height = 7, useDingbats = FALSE)
}

pad_range <- function(x, fraction) {
    r <- range(x, finite = TRUE)
    r + c(-1, 1) * diff(r) * fraction
}

# plotting helpers
base_plot <- function(df, field) {
    p <- ggplot(df, aes(pt_route1, pt_route2, colour = .data[[field]])) + geom_point_rast(alpha = 0.2, size = 0.5, 
        raster.dpi = 300)
    p + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray67") + theme_bw() + labs(x = "Pseudotime Lineage 1", 
        y = "Pseudotime Lineage 2")
}

```

### Diffusion map with all seven metaprograms

```{r diffusion_map_all_metaprograms}

library(destiny)
scores <- as.matrix(training$metadata[, training$features])
set.seed(1234)
dm_all <- DiffusionMap(scores)

```

### Proliferation relative to the other metaprograms

```{r proliferation_diffusion_panel}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  library(plot3D)

  # seven-program centroids
  training <- list(coordinates = eigenvectors(dm_all)[, 1:3, drop = FALSE], metadata = training$metadata, signs = rep(1, 3))
  df <- as.data.frame(training$coordinates)
  names(df) <- paste0('DC', 1:3)
  df$metaprogram <- as.character(training$metadata$melanoma_mp)
  centres <- df %>% group_by(metaprogram) %>% summarise(across(DC1:DC3, mean), .groups = 'drop')
  points <- as.matrix(centres[, c('DC1', 'DC2', 'DC3')])
  prolif <- centres$metaprogram == 'proliferation_cell_cycle'
  fit <- prcomp(points[!prolif, ], center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)
  basis <- fit$rotation[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
  uv <- sweep(points[!prolif, ], 2, fit$center, '-') %*% basis

  # reference plane
  u <- pad_range(uv[, 1], 0.20)
  v <- pad_range(uv[, 2], 0.20)
  corners <- rbind(c(u[1], v[1]), c(u[2], v[1]), c(u[1], v[2]), c(u[2], v[2]))
  plane <- t(apply(corners, 1, function(x) fit$center + x[1] * basis[, 1] + x[2] * basis[, 2]))
  xlim <- pad_range(c(df$DC1, plane[, 1]), 0.04)
  ylim <- pad_range(c(df$DC2, plane[, 2]), 0.04)
  zlim <- pad_range(c(df$DC3, plane[, 3]), 0.04)

  # proliferation panel
  open_panel('S7B_proliferation_diffusion_plane')
  surf3D(x = matrix(plane[, 1], 2, byrow = TRUE), y = matrix(plane[, 2], 2, byrow = TRUE), z = matrix(plane[, 3], 2, byrow = TRUE), colvar = NULL, col = adjustcolor('grey75', alpha.f = 0.25), border = 'grey55', colkey = FALSE, theta = 70, phi = 18, expand = 0.8, xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, zlim = zlim, xlab = 'DC1', ylab = 'DC2', zlab = 'DC3', ticktype = 'detailed', bty = 'g')
  for (mp in unique(df$metaprogram)) {
      cells <- df[df$metaprogram == mp, ]
      scatter3D(cells$DC1, cells$DC2, cells$DC3, colvar = NULL, col = adjustcolor(mp_pal[[mp]], alpha.f = 0.08), 
          pch = 16, cex = 0.25, add = TRUE)
  }
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(centres))) {
      mp <- centres$metaprogram[i]
      segments3D(fit$center[1], fit$center[2], fit$center[3], centres$DC1[i], centres$DC2[i], centres$DC3[i], col = mp_pal[[mp]], 
          lwd = ifelse(prolif[i], 4, 2), add = TRUE)
  }
  points3D(centres$DC1, centres$DC2, centres$DC3, colvar = NULL, pch = 21, cex = 1.6, col = 'black', bg = mp_pal[centres$metaprogram], add = TRUE)
  points3D(fit$center[1], fit$center[2], fit$center[3], colvar = NULL, pch = 23, cex = 1.1, col = 'black', bg = 'black', add = TRUE)
  text3D(centres$DC1 + 0.02 * diff(xlim), centres$DC2 + 0.01 * diff(ylim), centres$DC3 + 0.01 * diff(zlim), labels = diffusion_labels[centres$metaprogram], cex = 0.85, col = 'black', add = TRUE)
  dev.off()
}))

```

The proliferation/cell-cycle program separates from the other states in the seven-state map. We therefore exclude it when fitting the differentiation trajectories below.

### Diffusion map without proliferation

```{r melanoma_diffusion_map}

library(destiny)

# exclude proliferation cells and the proliferation score from trajectory fitting
features_use <- setdiff(training$features, 'proliferation_cell_cycle')
metadata <- training$metadata[training$metadata$melanoma_mp != 'proliferation_cell_cycle', ]
scores <- as.matrix(metadata[, features_use])

# diffusion map
set.seed(1234)
dm <- DiffusionMap(scores)

# diffusion coordinates
coordinates <- eigenvectors(dm)[, 1:3, drop = FALSE]
signs <- rep(1, 3)

```

### Melanoma trajectories

```{r melanoma_trajectories}

library(slingshot)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
training <- list(coordinates = coordinates, signs = signs, metadata = metadata, features = features_use)

# fit trajectories
sce <- SingleCellExperiment(colData = S4Vectors::DataFrame(training$metadata))
coordinates <- training$coordinates
colnames(coordinates) <- paste0('DC', 1:3)
reducedDims(sce)$DM <- coordinates
sce <- slingshot(sce, clusterLabels = 'melanoma_mp', reducedDim = 'DM', allow.breaks = FALSE, shrink = TRUE, extend = 'y', reweight = TRUE, reassign = TRUE, thresh = 0.001, maxit = 15, stretch = 2, smoother = 'smooth.spline', shrink.method = 'cosine')
fit <- SlingshotDataSet(sce)

```

### Fitted differentiation trajectories

```{r fitted_diffusion_panel}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  library(plot3D)

  # fitted diffusion space
  X <- training$coordinates
  mp <- as.character(training$metadata$melanoma_mp)
  df <- as.data.frame(X)
  names(df) <- paste0('DC', 1:3)
  df$metaprogram <- mp
  centres <- df %>% group_by(metaprogram) %>% summarise(across(DC1:DC3, median), .groups = 'drop')
  curves <- slingCurves(fit)

  # trajectory panel
  open_panel('S7C_fitted_diffusion_trajectories')
  scatter3D(X[, 1], X[, 2], X[, 3], colvar = NULL, col = adjustcolor(mp_pal[mp], alpha.f = 0.18), pch = 16, cex = 0.35, theta = 135, phi = 25, xlab = 'DC1', ylab = 'DC2', zlab = 'DC3', ticktype = 'detailed', bty = 'g')
  for (i in 1:2) {
      curve <- curves[[i]]$s[, 1:3, drop = FALSE]
      lines3D(curve[, 1], curve[, 2], curve[, 3], col = c("#E377C2", "#353C40")[i], lwd = 6, add = TRUE)
  }
  points3D(centres$DC1, centres$DC2, centres$DC3, colvar = NULL, pch = 21, cex = 1.8, col = 'black', bg = mp_pal[centres$metaprogram], add = TRUE)
  text3D(centres$DC1, centres$DC2 + 0.005, centres$DC3, labels = diffusion_labels[centres$metaprogram], adj = 0, cex = 0.9, add = TRUE)
  dev.off()
}))

```

### Metaprogram distributions along the fitted lineages

```{r training_trajectory_evidence}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  library(slingshot)

  # cell summaries
  pt <- slingPseudotime(fit)
  weights <- slingCurveWeights(fit, as.probs = FALSE)
  cells <- data.frame(cell = rownames(pt), metaprogram = training$metadata$melanoma_mp, training$coordinates, pt1 = pt[, 1], pt2 = pt[, 2], weight1 = weights[, 1], weight2 = weights[, 2])
  counts <- bind_rows(cells %>% filter(!is.na(pt1)) %>% dplyr::count(metaprogram) %>% mutate(lineage = 'Lineage 1'), cells %>% filter(!is.na(pt2)) %>% dplyr::count(metaprogram) %>% mutate(lineage = 'Lineage 2')) %>% mutate(include_density = n > 500)

  # export training-cell and density summaries
  write.csv(cells, file.path(result_dir, 'S7_training_trajectory_cells.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(counts, file.path(result_dir, 'S7DE_density_program_counts.csv'), row.names = FALSE)
  density_values <- bind_rows(data.frame(metaprogram = cells$metaprogram, pseudotime = pt[, 1], lineage = 'Lineage 1'),
                              data.frame(metaprogram = cells$metaprogram, pseudotime = pt[, 2], lineage = 'Lineage 2')) %>%
    filter(!is.na(pseudotime)) %>% group_by(lineage, metaprogram) %>% filter(n() > 500) %>% ungroup()
  write.csv(density_values, file.path(result_dir, 'S7DE_density_inputs.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

  # training densities
  df <- density_values
  for (i in 1:2) {
      cells <- filter(df, lineage == paste("Lineage", i))
      p <- ggplot(cells, aes(pseudotime, colour = metaprogram)) + geom_density() + theme_bw() +
        scale_colour_manual(values = mp_pal) + labs(x = paste0("Pseudotime (lineage ", i, ")"), y = "Density") + 
          theme(legend.position = "none")
      save_panel(p, paste0(c("S7D", "S7E")[i], "_training_density"), 5, 3)
  }
}))

```

### Project melanoma cells onto the trajectories

```{r project_melanoma_trajectories}

# projection scores
scores <- scale(as.matrix(mel[[]][, training$features]))
scores[scores > 3] <- 3
scores[scores < -3] <- -3
cells <- rownames(scores)
gc()

# diffusion projection
starts <- seq.int(1L, nrow(scores), by = 2000L)
parts <- lapply(starts, function(start) {
    index <- seq.int(start, min(start + 1999L, nrow(scores)))
    destiny::dm_predict(dm, scores[index, , drop = FALSE])[, 1:3, drop = FALSE]
})
coordinates <- do.call(rbind, parts)
coordinates <- sweep(coordinates, 2, training$signs, '*')
rownames(coordinates) <- cells
colnames(coordinates) <- paste0('DC', 1:3)

# trajectory projection
projected <- slingshot::predict(fit, newdata = coordinates)
pt_na <- slingPseudotime(projected)
pt <- slingPseudotime(projected, na = FALSE)
weights <- slingCurveWeights(projected, as.probs = FALSE)
assignment <- ifelse(is.na(pt_na[, 1]), 'Lineage 2', ifelse(is.na(pt_na[, 2]), 'Lineage 1', 'Shared Trunk'))
result <- data.frame(cell_id = cells, DM1 = coordinates[, 1], DM2 = coordinates[, 2], DM3 = coordinates[, 3], pt_route1_raw = pt[, 1], pt_route2_raw = pt[, 2], w1 = weights[, 1], w2 = weights[, 2], slingshot_lineage_assignment = assignment)

```

### Projected lineage weights before alignment

```{r raw_projection_panel}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  df <- result %>% mutate(pt_route1 = pt_route1_raw, pt_route2 = pt_route2_raw,
                         pt_merged = (pt_route1 + pt_route2) / 2, pt_class = 'Shared Trunk', weight = w1 + w2)
  skeleton <- make_centerline(filter(df, weight >= 1.5), "Shared Trunk", "pt_merged", n_bins = 70, span = 0.25)
  p <- base_plot(df, "weight") + geom_path(data = skeleton, aes(x = pt_route1_s, y = pt_route2_s), inherit.aes = FALSE, 
      colour = "gray37", linewidth = 1, lineend = "round") +
    scale_colour_gradient2(low = "indianred", mid = "white", high = "seagreen", midpoint = 1.5, name = "w1 + w2")
  save_panel(p, 'S7F_projection_weights', 5, 4)
}))

```

### Trajectory correction checkpoint

```{r align_trajectory_branches}

df <- result %>% mutate(pt_route1 = pt_route1_raw, pt_route2 = pt_route2_raw, pt_merged = (pt_route1 + pt_route2) / 2, delta = pt_route1 - pt_route2, pt_class = 'Shared Trunk')

# trunk correction
trunk <- make_centerline(df %>% filter(w1 + w2 >= 1.5), 'Shared Trunk', 'pt_merged', n_bins = 70, span = 0.25)
projection <- nearest_on_skeleton(as.matrix(df[, c('pt_route1', 'pt_route2')]), as.matrix(trunk[, c('pt_route1_s', 'pt_route2_s')]))
df$pt_route2 <- df$pt_route2_raw - (projection$pt2_line - projection$pt1_line)
df <- df %>% mutate(pt_merged = (pt_route1 + pt_route2) / 2, delta = pt_route1 - pt_route2)

```

### Projected lineage weights after alignment

```{r aligned_projection_panel}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  df <- df %>% mutate(pt_class = 'Shared Trunk', weight = w1 + w2)
  df$pt_merged <- (result$pt_route1_raw + result$pt_route2_raw) / 2
  skeleton <- make_centerline(filter(df, weight >= 1.5), "Shared Trunk", "pt_merged", n_bins = 70, span = 0.25)
  p <- base_plot(df, "weight") + geom_path(data = skeleton, aes(x = pt_route1_s, y = pt_route2_s), inherit.aes = FALSE, 
      colour = "gray37", linewidth = 1, lineend = "round") +
    scale_colour_gradient2(low = "indianred", mid = "white", high = "seagreen", midpoint = 1.5, name = "w1 + w2")
  save_panel(p, 'S7G_aligned_weights', 5, 4)
}))

```

### Locate the shared-trunk fork

```{r infer_trajectory_fork}

# locate the fork from pseudotime dispersion
dispersion <- df %>% mutate(bin = ntile(pt_merged, 100)) %>% group_by(bin) %>% summarise(prog = median(pt_merged), mads = mad(delta), .groups = 'drop') %>% arrange(prog)
fork <- dispersion$prog[which(dispersion$mads > 0.10 * max(dispersion$mads, na.rm = TRUE))[1]]

```

### Pseudotime dispersion and selected fork

```{r trajectory_fork_panel}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  # fork dispersion
  df <- dispersion
  df$mad_s <- predict(loess(mads ~ prog, data = df, span = 0.3, degree = 2))
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(prog, mads)) + geom_point() + geom_line(aes(y = mad_s), colour = 'red') + theme_bw() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = fork, linetype = 'dashed') + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed') +
    labs(x = 'Merged pseudotime', y = 'Dispersion (MAD)')
  save_panel(p, 'S7I_fork_dispersion', 4, 3)
}))

```

### Identify distant projections

```{r identify_trajectory_outliers}

df <- df %>% mutate(pt_class = ifelse(pt_merged < fork, 'Shared Trunk', ifelse(w2 < w1, 'Lineage 1', ifelse(w1 < w2, 'Lineage 2', 'Shared Trunk'))))
skeleton <- bind_rows(make_centerline(df, 'Shared Trunk', 'pt_merged', n_bins = 70, span = 0.25), make_centerline(df, 'Lineage 1', 'pt_route1', n_bins = 90, span = 0.30), make_centerline(df, 'Lineage 2', 'pt_route2', n_bins = 90, span = 0.30))

# outlier distances
df$cl_dist <- NA_real_
for (cl in unique(df$pt_class)) {
    index <- which(df$pt_class == cl)
    s <- skeleton %>% filter(pt_class == cl)
    df$cl_dist[index] <- vapply(index, function(i) sqrt(min((s$pt_route1_s - df$pt_route1[i])^2 + (s$pt_route2_s - 
        df$pt_route2[i])^2)), numeric(1))
}
threshold <- mean(df$cl_dist) + 3 * sd(df$cl_dist)
df$cl_far <- df$cl_dist > threshold
noise_sd <- median(df$cl_dist[!df$cl_far], na.rm = TRUE)

```

### Flagged projections

```{r trajectory_outlier_panel}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  # flagged cells
  df <- df %>% mutate(flagged = factor(cl_far, levels = c(FALSE, TRUE), labels = c('No', 'Yes')))
  p <- base_plot(df, 'flagged') + scale_colour_manual(values = c('No' = 'gray87', 'Yes' = 'indianred'), name = 'Flagged') +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3))) +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  save_panel(p, 'S7H_flagged_cells')
}))

```

### Apply trajectory corrections

```{r apply_trajectory_corrections}

correction <- list(metadata = df, skeleton = skeleton, dispersion = dispersion, fork = fork, threshold = threshold, noise_sd = noise_sd)

path <- file.path(input_dir, 'trajectory_outlier_coordinates.csv')
retained <- read.csv(path)
before_outlier <- df[, c('pt_route1', 'pt_route2', 'pt_merged', 'delta', 'pt_class'), drop = FALSE]
colnames(before_outlier) <- paste0(colnames(before_outlier), '_aligned')
df <- correct_trajectory_outliers(correction, retained = retained)
df <- cbind(df, before_outlier)

```

### Retain the corrected trajectory coordinates

```{r retain_trajectory_metadata}

index <- match(colnames(mel), df$cell_id)
metadata <- df[index, setdiff(names(df), 'cell_id'), drop = FALSE]
rownames(metadata) <- colnames(mel)
mel <- AddMetaData(mel, metadata)

```

### Corrected trajectories and metaprograms

```{r corrected_trajectory_panels}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  final <- trajectory_cells(mel)

  # final classes
  p <- base_plot(final, 'pt_class') + scale_colour_manual(values = route_cols) + theme(legend.position = 'none')
  save_panel(p, 'S7J_final_trajectory_classes')

  # metaprogram projection
  index <- match(final$cell_id, colnames(mel))
  final$melanoma_mp <- as.character(mel$melanoma_mp[index])
  skeleton <- bind_rows(make_centerline(final, 'Shared Trunk', 'pt_merged', n_bins = 70, span = 0.25), make_centerline(final, 'Lineage 1', 'pt_route1', n_bins = 90, span = 0.30), make_centerline(final, 'Lineage 2', 'pt_route2', n_bins = 90, span = 0.30))
  centres <- final %>% group_by(melanoma_mp) %>% summarise(pt_route1 = median(pt_route1), pt_route2 = median(pt_route2), .groups = 'drop')
  p <- base_plot(final, 'melanoma_mp') + geom_path(data = skeleton, aes(x = pt_route1_s, y = pt_route2_s, colour = pt_class), linewidth = 1, lineend = 'round') +
    geom_point(data = centres, aes(colour = melanoma_mp), shape = 23, fill = 'white', size = 3) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(mp_pal, route_cols)) + guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 3)))
  save_panel(p, 'Figure_2F_metaprogram_trajectories', 6, 4)
}))

```

### Metaprogram composition along the trajectories

```{r metaprogram_trajectory_enrichment}

withr::with_preserve_seed(local({
  metadata <- trajectory_cells(mel)
  index <- match(metadata$cell_id, colnames(mel))
  metadata$melanoma_mp <- as.character(mel$melanoma_mp[index])
  membership <- final %>% distinct(community, metaprogram)

  # enrichment
  counts <- table(metadata$melanoma_mp, metadata$pt_class)
  test <- chisq.test(counts)
  values <- as.data.frame(counts) %>% dplyr::rename(metaprogram = Var1, trajectory = Var2, cells = Freq) %>%
    group_by(metaprogram) %>% mutate(program_cells = sum(cells), percentage_within_programme = 100 * cells / program_cells) %>% ungroup() %>%
    group_by(trajectory) %>% mutate(trajectory_cells = sum(cells), percentage_within_trajectory_class = 100 * cells / trajectory_cells) %>% ungroup()
  values$expected <- as.vector(test$expected)
  values$log2_OE <- log2(values$cells / values$expected)
  values$programme <- membership$community[match(values$metaprogram, membership$metaprogram)]
  classes <- c('Shared Trunk' = 'Shared trunk', 'Lineage 1' = 'L1', 'Lineage 2' = 'L2')
  values$trajectory_class <- unname(classes[as.character(values$trajectory)])

  write.csv(values, file.path(result_dir, 'Figure_2G_metaprogram_trajectory_enrichment.csv'), row.names = FALSE)

  df <- values
  programs <- c('epithelial_adjacent', 'early_developmental_stress', 'proliferation_cell_cycle', 'differentiated_melanocytic', 'ifn_associated_stress', 'nevus_like_senescence', 'mesenchymal_invasive')
  labels <- c('Epithelial-adjacent', 'Developmental', 'Proliferative', 'Melanocytic', 'IFN-associated', 'Nevus-like', 'Mesenchymal-invasive')
  df$metaprogram <- factor(df$metaprogram, levels = rev(programs), labels = rev(labels))
  df$trajectory <- factor(df$trajectory, levels = c('Shared Trunk', 'Lineage 1', 'Lineage 2'))

  # enrichment panel
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(trajectory, metaprogram, fill = log2_OE)) + geom_tile(colour = 'white', linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf('%.1f%%\n[%.1f%%]', percentage_within_programme, percentage_within_trajectory_class), colour = abs(log2_OE) > 1.5), lineheight = 0.9, size = 3.2) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c('FALSE' = 'black', 'TRUE' = 'white'), guide = 'none') +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = 'steelblue4', mid = 'white', high = 'firebrick3', midpoint = 0, limits = c(-3, 3), oob = scales::squish, name = expression(log[2]('O/E'))) +
    coord_fixed() + theme_classic() + labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, caption = 'Row %; [column %]') +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10), plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0))
  path <- file.path(result_dir, 'Figure_2G_metaprogram_trajectory_enrichment.pdf')
  ggsave(path, p, width = 5, height = 5, useDingbats = FALSE)
}))

```

}))
